hooks.command:
cat > /tmp/claude-checklist.txt << 'EOF'
✅ 3-STEP MODIFICATION CHECKLIST

1️⃣  MAINTAIN DOCUMENTATION
   Update docs/ files that describe modified behavior
   → README.md → docs/setup/ → docs/arch/

2️⃣  UPDATE CHANGELOG
   Add entry to docs/changelog.md (top of file)
   Format: ## [YYYY-MM-DD] Functional title

3️⃣  TRACE BLOCKERS & ALARMS
   Instrument potential bottlenecks
   → Log [ALARME] in ERROR on confirmed issues

See .claude/CLAUDE.md for full details.
EOF
cat /tmp/claude-checklist.txt && echo ''
